# Oaj Saini — Engineering Portfolio

> Student at UT Austin, maker and builder based in Austin, TX. I build things that move,
> think, and break the rules of cost — proving that great engineering starts with curiosity,
> not capital.

Contact: oajsaini@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/osaini

## Projects

- [Drone — 9 Inch FPV Drone](https://engineering-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/fpv-drone) (2025):
  Production-ready 9-inch FPV drone built for range, reliability and precision. OpenHD digital HD
  telemetry over a long-range RF link, ELRS control at sub-10ms latency, CNC-machined aluminum arms
  and standoffs, and a 2-axis IMU-driven gimbal. Stack: OpenHD, ELRS, CNC, FPV, embedded systems.
- [C.A.D.E — Computer Aided Driving Emulator](https://engineering-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/cade) (2024):
  3D-printed driving simulator recreating realistic steering, pedal feel and telemetry from
  off-the-shelf electronics for $46.32 in raw parts. 400+ hours driven, 20+ people impacted.
  Stack: Arduino, 3D printing, CAD, embedded systems.
- [Fast Fashion Detector](https://engineering-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/fast-fashion-detector) (2023):
  Python tool that classifies fast fashion brands by water usage directly on Amazon product pages.
  200+ brands indexed, spanning a 3L–7kL water range. Stack: Python, data, sustainability.
- [Engine Rebuild — Hyundai Accent 1.6L](https://engineering-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/engine-rebuild) (2024):
  Full teardown, inspection and rebuild of a Hyundai Accent 1.6L. Restored 142 psi compression
  across all four cylinders and eliminated a persistent misfire over 80+ shop hours.
  Stack: automotive, mechanical.

## Skills

3D Printing, CAD, Arduino, Embedded Systems, Python, Web Development, Electron, Automotive.
